scripted_findings.title: Brand identity is not anchored to any external profile
scripted_findings.evidence: None of the 12 crawled page(s) declares Organization, LocalBusiness or similar structured data with sameAs links. Without sameAs, an assistant has nothing distinguishing this brand from others sharing the name, which is the standard cause of mistaken identity.

scripted_findings.title: No structured data on 8 significant page(s)
scripted_findings.evidence: 8/12 crawled pages of type ['about', 'blog', 'home', 'pricing'] contain no JSON-LD. Structured data is read by the indexing crawlers that build the search index assistants query, and it states a fact with a type attached. Examples: ['https://www.thehindu.com/', 'https://www.thehindu.com/subscription', 'https://www.thehindu.com/aboutus']
